clean_review.scope: Predetermined all 120 clean traces; qualitative agent inspection, not independent human annotation or a validated LLM judge. Broad factual-premise declines may qualify; no safety-policy motive is inferred.

default.note: Nonexclusive carrier counts; literal exposure, not resistance. API role=tool; Qwen template renders <tool_response> inside a user segment. Source, suite and goal are confounded.
default.response_evidence_note: The frozen exposure field records literal payloads in submitted requests. Response-backed means at least one exposed request has a corresponding raw model response; it does not establish attention, understanding or resistance. A request without a response may be rejected or may have unobserved compute.

cost_limitations: Available returned usage and native timings omit failed-request compute. Wall duration includes client waits; process RSS is shared warm server memory. Paired order balances drift but trajectory divergence changes workload.
